bullets.text: A deaf boy in Tiruttani was killed by a train while relieving himself outdoors due to no toilet at home, so the office should check sanitation infrastructure.
Plans for a flyover on the Radial Road aim to ease traffic while protecting the Pallikaranai Marshland, so the office must monitor environmental safeguards during implementation.
Samayam Tamil highlighted the Pallikaranai Marshland flyover and road project as a turning point for Chennai traffic, and the office should track local public reception.
Auto drivers protested in Pethikuppam near Uthukottai against free bus travel, and the office should monitor transport tensions and driver grievances in the area.
Jaya Plus reported potential mineral theft in Manjakaranai Lake, and the office must direct district authorities to investigate the illegal mining allegations immediately.
Rainwater mixed with sewage in Ambattur industrial estate, and the office should instruct municipal engineers to inspect and resolve the drainage contamination promptly.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay and Singapore Deputy PM Gan Kim Yong opened a CapitaLand data centre in Ambattur, expanding digital infrastructure.
Telangana is inviting Tamil Nadu businesses to join its drone park ecosystem, so the IT ministry should review competitive strategies for local drone development.
Huawei and partners launched the Global AI CITY Innovation Alliance in Shanghai, and our portfolio team should watch for partnership opportunities in smart city tech.
TVK announced a two lakh rupee reward for information on a missing seven-year-old girl in Gingee, and the office should monitor search updates and law enforcement progress.
